review_candidates.description: Back Technical Customer Support 2 JOB_DESCRIPTION.SHARE.HTML CAROUSEL_PARAGRAPH JOB_DESCRIPTION.SHARE.HTML Saint-Laurent, Canada Customer Experience Hybrid 4649 Intrado Life & Safety, Inc. mail_outline Get future jobs matching this search or Job Description About Us Intrado se consacre à sauver des vies et à protéger les communautés, en les aidant à se préparer, à répondre et à se remettre des événements critiques. Notre entreprise de pointe s’efforce de devenir le partenaire de services d’urgence le plus fiable et axé sur les données, en unifiant les communications fragmentées pour fournir une intelligence exploitable aux premiers intervenants. Chez Intrado, tout notre travail a véritablement de l’importance. Intrado is dedicated to saving lives and protecting communities, helping them prepare for, respond to, and recover from critical events. Our cutting-edge company strives to become the most trusted, data-centric emergency services partner by uniting fragmented communications into actionable intelligence for first responders. At Intrado, all of our work truly matters. Responsibilities/Qualifications Depuis plus de 40 ans, Intrado est à l'avant garde des améliorations apportées au réseau 911 et aux solutions de prise d'appels, contribuant ainsi à améliorer la qualité des interventions d'urgence au Canada, aux États Unis et outre mer. Intrado aide les fournisseurs de services de télécommunications et les organismes de sécurité publique à sauver des vies en transformant les services de communication d'urgence. Conformément à notre position de leader en Amérique du Nord pour la fourniture de solutions de traitement des appels d'urgence 911 , nous avons entrepris une refonte importante de nos applications afin d'offrir une solution de traitement des appels d'urgence basée sur le Web et le Cloud. La prochaine génération de 911 (NG911) est actuellement en cours de développement pour s'adapter aux dernières technologies mobiles! Intrado cherche à embaucher un spécialiste du soutien technique (niveau 2) pour rejoindre notre équipe. Ce poste sera assigné à un quart une fois la formation terminée avec succès. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe d'environ 30 personnes travaillant au bureau d'assistance à distance et formée pour devenir un expert de nos technologies 911 et soutenir nos clients du centre d'appels 911. Ce poste est hybride avec (2) jours au bureau (7150 Rue Alexander Fleming, Saint Laurent QC) Responsabilités Essentielles : Servir de point de contact principal pour les problèmes des clients en effectuant la triage initiale, l’analyse technique et le dépannage avancé des services Intrado et des solutions 911. Répondre aux appels de soutien technique en dehors des heures normales, assurer une réponse rapide aux incidents critiques, initier les procédures de soutien et escalader aux ingénieurs de garde ou aux équipes spécialisées au besoin. Créer, mettre à jour et résoudre les billets de soutien avec une documentation précise des étapes de dépannage, des impacts, des causes probables et des communications avec le client. Surveiller les alertes de service, les tableaux de bord et les indicateurs de santé des plateformes pour identifier et résoudre les problèmes de manière proactive. Collaborer avec les équipes techniques internes, les opérations réseau et les équipes produits pour assurer une résolution rapide des problèmes. Soutenir les initiatives du département en préparant la documentation technique, en contribuant à la base de connaissances, en générant des rapports opérationnels et en aidant à la coordination des tâches de projet. Maintenir un haut niveau d’expertise produit sur les plateformes Intrado afin d’assurer un diagnostic précis, une escalade appropriée et un accompagnement efficace des clients. Formation : Diplôme de deux ans d’un collège ou d’une université accréditée en systèmes d’information, informatique ou domaine connexe (préféré). Une expérience professionnelle équivalente dans un poste similaire peut remplacer les exigences scolaires. Certifications (p. ex., CCNA, CCNP, MCSE) souhaitées. Expérience : Deux ans d’expérience en soutien technique à la clientèle, idéalement dans un environnement de centre d’assistance ou de soutien à distance pour des systèmes logiciels complexes. Expérience avec des systèmes critiques à haute disponibilité et des environnements VoIP (préférée). Deux ans d’expérience en concepts réseau, dépannage de systèmes IP et soutien de serveurs et postes Windows (requis). Connaissance de base en câblage et infrastructure physique (Cat5e/Cat6, normes RJ45, outils de test réseau, dépannage de connectivité téléphonique) (préférée). Connaissances de base en téléphonie (POTS, SIP, tip and ring, blocs de raccordement, flux MDF/IDF) (préférée). Expérience de base avec des outils ou technologies assistés par IA pour le dépannage, la documentation ou l’amélioration des flux de travail (préférée). Maîtrise intermédiaire de Microsoft Excel, Word et Outlook (requis). Capacité à travailler par quarts rotatifs, incluant soirées, fins de semaine et jours fériés, selon les besoins des opérations de soutien 24/7. En raison de la nature de certains de nos partenariats et clients aux États-Unis et au Canada, ce poste exige que les candidats soient fluents en anglais et en français For more than 40 years, Intrado has pioneered improvements to the 911 network and call taking solutions, helping to enhance the quality of emergency response in Canada, United States and overseas. Intrado helps telecommunications service providers and public safety agencies save lives by transforming emergency communications services. Consistent with our leading position in North America for providing solutions in 911 emergency calls processing, we have undertaken a significant redesign of our applications in order to offer Web and Cloud based Emergency Call Handling solution. The Next Generation 911 (NG911) is currently being developed to accommodate the latest mobile technologies; a time of opportunities! Intrado is looking to hire a Technical Support Specialist (level 2) to join our team. This role will be assigned a shift once it has successfully finished training. You will be part of a team of around 30 people working the Remote Help Desk and trained to become an expert of our 911 technologies and support our 911 call center clients. This position is hybrid with (2) days in the office (7150 Rue Alexander Fleming, Saint Laurent QC) Essential Duties: Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming customer issues by providing initial triage, technical analysis, and advanced troubleshooting for Intrado services and 911 solutions. Handle after-hours technical support calls, ensuring prompt response to service-impacting incidents, initiating critical support procedures, and escalating to on-call engineers or specialized teams when required. Create, update, and resolve support tickets with precise documentation of troubleshooting steps, impact, root cause indicators, and customer communications. Monitor service alerts, system dashboards, and platform health indicators to identify and address issues proactively. Collaborate with internal technical teams, network operations, and product teams to drive timely resolution of customer issues. Support departmental initiatives by preparing technical documentation, contributing to knowledge base content, generating operational reports, and assisting with coordination of project tasks. Maintain a high level of product expertise across supported Intrado platforms to ensure accurate diagnosis, proper escalation paths, and effective customer guidance. Education Two-year degree from an accredited college or university with major coursework in MIS, computer science, or a related field is preferred Equivalent work experience in a similar position may be substituted for educational requirements. Certifications (e.g. Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE), etc.) preferred Experience: 2+ years of technical customer support experience required, preferably in a helpdesk or remote support environment supporting complex software systems. Experience working with critical, high-availability systems and VoIP-based environments preferred. Two years of experience with networking concepts, troubleshooting IP-based systems, and supporting Windows servers and workstations required. Familiarity with cabling and physical infrastructure, including running and terminating Cat5e/Cat6, RJ45 standards, basic network test tools, and troubleshooting telephony-related connectivity preferred. Basic telephony knowledge (POTS, SIP, tip and ring, punch-down blocks, MDF/IDF workflow) preferred. Basic experience using AI-assisted tools or technologies to support troubleshooting, documentation, or workflow improvement preferred. Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook required. Ability to work rotating shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed for 24/7 support operations. Due to the nature of some of our partnerships and clients in both USA and Canada, this role does require candidates to be fluent in English and French Il est important que l’anglais soit inclus dans nos exigences de communication, puisque le siège social de notre entreprise est situé aux États-Unis et que nous collaborons régulièrement avec des équipes américaines. Compte tenu de la nature de nos activités et de notre rôle dans le soutien des services essentiels de sécurité publique, notamment les communications d’urgence du 911, la capacité de communiquer efficacement en anglais est essentielle afin d’assurer une collaboration harmonieuse, une efficacité opérationnelle optimale et la prestation de services de haute qualité à nos clients et partenaires. It is important that English be included in our communication requirements, as our company’s headquarters are located in the United States and we regularly collaborate with U.S.-based teams. Given the nature of our business and our role in supporting essential public safety services, including 911 emergency communications, the ability to communicate effectively in English is critical to ensuring seamless collaboration, optimal operational efficiency, and the delivery of high-quality services to our customers and partners. Total Rewards Vous voulez aimer là où vous travaillez? Chez Intrado, nous offrons un régime complet d’avantages sociaux qui comprend ce que vous attendez (assurance médicale, assurance dentaire et assurance des soins de la vue, assurance-vie et assurance invalidité, congés payés, régime enregistré d’épargne-retraite (REER), et plusieurs avantages qui excèderont vos attentes, tels que le remboursement de frais de scolarité, des congés parentaux payés, l’accès à une bibliothèque complète de ressources de formation personnelle et professionnelle, des rabais d’employés, des assurances couvrant et plus encore! Postulez dès aujourd’hui pour vous joindre à nous dans un travail qui en vaut la peine! Want to love where you work? At Intrado, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes what you’d expect (medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, paid time off, a Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP), and several that go above and beyond – tuition reimbursement, paid parental leave, access to a comprehensive library of personal and professional training resources, employee discounts, insurance coverage and more! Apply today to join us in work worth doing! review_candidates.description: Your Mission We are looking for an experienced AWS Cloud Platform Engineer to design, build, and manage foundational AWS cloud infrastructure. The role focuses on AWS account management, networking, identity and access management, security boundaries, and reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, Terraform, cloud security, and DevOps practices, ensuring a secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platform for application and engineering teams. What You'll Do Design, provision, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure across multiple accounts and environments. Build and maintain AWS networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups, and connectivity. Implement IAM roles, permissions, identity boundaries, and secure cross-account access. Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules for standardized infrastructure provisioning. Establish AWS account structures, governance policies, security controls, and environment isolation. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for automated infrastructure deployment. Implement infrastructure monitoring, logging, and alerting using AWS-native and third-party tools. Collaborate with platform engineering, security, and development teams to support cloud infrastructure requirements. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues and optimize cloud performance, reliability, and costs. What You Bring 5+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering. Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including VPC, IAM, EC2, Route 53, S3, and CloudWatch. Experience designing and managing multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations and Control Tower. Advanced proficiency in Terraform and reusable Infrastructure as Code modules. Strong understanding of AWS networking, security boundaries, IAM policies, and cross-account access. Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools. Proficiency in scripting using Python, Bash, or similar languages. Experience implementing cloud security, infrastructure monitoring, and operational best practices. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills. Nice-to-have Skills Experience with AWS EKS, Kubernetes, and containerized infrastructure. Knowledge of GitOps tools such as Argo CD. Experience with AWS Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and hybrid cloud connectivity. Familiarity with AWS security and governance services such as CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, and Security Hub. Experience with AWS cost optimization and FinOps practices. AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional certification. What We Offer At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer: A people-first culture: Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging. Smart, purposeful collaboration: Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges. Balance that lasts: We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life. Room to grow: Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you. Meaningful rewards: Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential. Ready to Apply ? Let's build the future of health together. (ref:hirist.tech)

review_candidates.title: Multi-Site Data Center Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: LightEdge Solutions is developing the IT solutions that will propel businesses forward over the next 10 years. Using a combination of shared and private/dedicated platforms, LightEdge has been successful in offering businesses alternatives that streamline operations, improve reliability and reduce costs. If you are passionate about creating real solutions that help businesses with cutting-edge technology, want to be challenged to think out of the box and be in a position where you can impact change on a daily basis, then LightEdge can offer you a dynamic corporate environment built on teamwork and personal responsibility. Position Summary The Multi-Site Data Center Operations Manager leads Lightedge’s DCOPS technicians and daily operations across assigned third-party colocation sites. Based in Lewisville, Texas or St. Louis, MO this working manager combines direct, hands-on operational support with remote leadership of small teams or individual technicians in remote locations. The role travels regularly to provide onsite oversight, coaching, project support, and operational consistency. The manager is accountable for Lightedge’s rack-level operations, customer deployment support, staffing, service quality, and incident response. The third-party colocation providers own and maintain facility infrastructure, including building electrical distribution, UPS systems, generators, cooling, and fire/life safety systems. This role coordinates with those providers regarding service delivery, planned maintenance, access, and incidents affecting Lightedge operations. Key Responsibilities Multi-Site Team Leadership Manage DCOPS technicians across assigned sites, including locations staffed by a single technician; establish clear responsibilities, priorities, and performance expectations. Coach and develop employees through regular individual meetings, onsite visits, skills assessments, cross-training, and performance reviews; support recruiting and onboarding. Build staffing, scheduling, and coverage plans for normal operations, vacations, absences, projects, and incidents; coordinate backup support and provider remote-hands services where needed. Plan regular site visits based on operational needs, staffing, risk, and project activity; maintain effective communication and accountability between visits. Capacity planning, power/space utilization, and coordination across multiple teams. Rack-Level Operations and Customer Support Oversee and perform authorized installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and removal of servers, network devices, storage equipment, rack PDUs, and associated cabling. Coordinate rack layouts, equipment placement, cable management, labeling, asset inventory, and rack power and airflow practices within provider requirements and approved capacity limits. Work with project managers, systems engineers, network teams, and customers to deliver deployments, migrations, upgrades, and decommissions accurately and on schedule. Prioritize tickets and work orders; verify completion, documentation, and service quality, including work performed by provider remote-hands personnel. Incident Response, On-Call, and Change Management Participate as an active member of technician on-call rotation, including after-hours, weekend, and holiday response as scheduled; provide hands-on onsite support when required. Coordinate operational incident response across assigned sites, including escalation, troubleshooting, provider engagement, stakeholder updates, and service restoration. Review and approve operational changes within assigned authority; ensure clear methods of procedure, risk assessments, rollback plans, and compliance with change management requirements. Document incidents, support root-cause reviews, and track corrective actions to completion; maintain current runbooks and escalation contacts. Colocation Provider Coordination and Operational Controls Serve as Lightedge’s primary operational contact for assigned colocation providers; coordinate access, deliveries, remote hands, maintenance notifications, and service escalations. Review provider maintenance notices and assess potential effects on Lightedge services; coordinate internal readiness and follow up on provider incidents or service concerns. Conduct site and rack inspections for organization, cabling, asset accuracy, access compliance, and adherence to procedures; maintain records supporting audits and customer requirements. Maintain consistent operating procedures across sites; monitor ticket performance, deployment quality, incident trends, staffing coverage, and corrective actions. Manage assigned operational budgets and expenses, including travel, supplies, and remote-hands services; identify practical cost and efficiency improvements. Perform other duties consistent with the scope of the role. Required Qualifications 6–8 years of relevant data center operations, colocation, or IT infrastructure experience, including experience leading technicians or operational teams. Demonstrated ability to manage distributed staff, prioritize work across multiple locations, and support sites with limited local staffing. Hands-on experience with server and network hardware, rack PDUs, structured cabling, equipment installations, inventory controls, and hardware troubleshooting. Working knowledge of A/B rack power, rack capacity, airflow, physical access controls, and colocation operations sufficient to recognize issues and coordinate provider response. Experience with ticketing systems, operational documentation, change management, incident response, and customer-facing service delivery. Strong communication, organization, and judgment; ability to work independently and lead teams through time-sensitive operational issues. Ability to work onsite in Lewisville, travel regularly to assigned locations, and fulfill scheduled on-call and after-hours responsibilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing multiple colocation sites and third-party providers; experience with remote-hands services, customer deployments, and compliance audits. An associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred. Relevant technical or IT service management certifications are a plus. With over 20 years in business, LightEdge offers a full stack of best-in-class IT services delivering flexibility, security, and control. Our solutions include premier colocation across seven purpose-built data centers spanning Des Moines, IA, Kansas City, MO, Omaha, NE, Austin, TX, and Raleigh, NC, industry-leading private Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and cloud platforms, and the top global security and compliance measures. Our owned and operated facilities, integrated DR solutions, and premium compliant cloud choices make up a true Hybrid Cloud Solution Center. LightEdge annually undergoes third-party audits for ISO 20000-1, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS 3.2, and SSAE 18 SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Regular or Temporary: Regular Language Fluency: English (Required) Work Shift: 1st shift (United States of America) Please review the following job description: Senior leader responsible for end-to-end production operations, stability, and resiliency across Truist’s Enterprise Payments application portfolio — a mission-critical ecosystem enabling real-time movement of client funds across ACH, wire, and instant payment rails. This portfolio represents one of the most operationally critical segments within Truist, with a high concentration of Tier 1 systems, money-movement platforms, and SOX-regulated applications, directly impacting client liquidity, financial risk, and firm reputation. Leads a large production support organization of full-time and contingent resources and serves as the single accountable production support leader for Enterprise Payments, partnering closely with application delivery to ensure 24x7x365 availability, rapid incident response, and end-to-end operational integrity, while continuously improving resiliency across payment systems. This role is both operational and transformational. The leader is accountable for maintaining stability across highly available systems while driving the evolution of the production support operating model through automation - advancing toward a modern, automation-first, engineering-aligned model aligned to modern DevSecOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, with accountability for improving resiliency and non-functional requirements across the application lifecycle. This includes establishing SLO/SLI frameworks and reliability governance, and driving continuous improvement of non-functional requirements such as availability, recoverability, and performance, while expanding observability, AI-driven operations, and intelligent automation across production support functions to reduce manual toil and enable self-healing capabilities. Serves as the senior escalation point for major incidents and operational risk, providing clear executive-level communication on system health and influencing enterprise priorities through a lens of stability, resilience, and business impact. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. Manages a single technology operations job area, overseeing multiple teams led by mid to upperlevel managers to deliver secure, reliable services that support business objectives. Establishes short to midterm operational plans for the technology operations job area and recommends strategies and priorities that align with enterprise and corporate technology direction. Manages the execution of technology strategies defined by executives and senior management within the job area, translating them into clear goals, roadmaps, and delivery expectations for managed teams. Implements and refines governance, risk management, and compliance practices for the job area, ensuring alignment with enterprise frameworks and effective control execution. Oversees key technology initiatives and operational improvement programs within the job area, delivering measurable gains in stability, efficiency, and business value. Partners with senior leaders and stakeholders to share operational insights, performance trends, and risk perspectives from the job area, informing adjustments to broader technology and business plans. Leads innovation within the job area by defining and promoting improved standards, processes, and operating models, and by driving adoption of automation and relevant emerging technologies. Owns key vendor, partner, and stakeholder relationships for the job area, influencing contract outcomes, service levels, and investments to meet operational and financial objectives. Monitors operational performance and financial results for the job area, managing to an approved budget and leading continuous improvement to optimize cost, quality, resilience, and colleague experience. Provides leadership, coaching, and development for managers and senior individual contributors within the job area, building the capabilities needed to execute current and future plans. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field. Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in technology operations. Broad leadership and management experience leading complex technology operations teams. Expertise in IT infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, compliance, and enterprise risk management. Experience with centralized payment services / payment hub architectures (ISO 20022, NACHA, SWIFT message formats). 3,Extensive experience managing large, complex technology organizations and budgets in a regulated environment. Hands-on experience building and deploying automation at scale using platforms such as Ansible, ServiceNow Orchestration/Flow Designer, or equivalent execution frameworks. Experience with modern observability platforms (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog, or equivalent) and implementing SLO-based reliability engineering. Executive presence with the ability to operate at CIO/CTO-level discussions and translate payments operational risk into business impact narratives. Experience driving adoption of AI/ML capabilities in production operations, including self-healing automation, predictive incident detection, and intelligent runbook automation. Strong business acumen with experience driving organizational change and innovation in financial services. Track record of building and transforming large production support organizations from manual, tiered support models to automated, DevSecOps-aligned operating models. Experience managing global or follow-the-sun production support operations with mixed teammate and contingent workforce models. Experience with cloud infrastructure operations, particularly AWS, and hybrid cloud/on-premises production environments for mission-critical financial systems. Experience with data center operations, infrastructure lifecycle management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning for mission-critical financial systems. Demonstrated success improving production stability and reducing customer-impacting incidents through automation of ITIL production support functions — particularly incident management, event correlation, alert triage, batch monitoring, change validation, and service request fulfillment.
